annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA); Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
key_provisions_or_claims: Exempts certain remotely piloted aircraft operations from Civil Aviation Safety Regulations requirements for beyond visual line of sight flight.
Made under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998.
Registered 27 August 2024 (F2024L01057); in force until 31 August 2026.
annotation.summary_en: Australian CASA legislative instrument (EX51/24) granting an exemption permitting remotely piloted aircraft operations beyond visual line of sight under the Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998. Registered 27 August 2024 and in effect until 31 August 2026. Only metadata is shown, not the exemption conditions.
annotation.title_clean: CASA EX51/24 — Remotely Piloted Aircraft Operations Beyond Visual Line of Sight Exemption 2024
